items.name: utils
items.title: Eolas UI Utilities
items.description: Core utility library exporting cn(), assetUrl(), sanitizeUrl(), composeClassName(), resolveNativeButton(), mergeRefs(), useMergedRefs(), and Base UI authoring hooks: mergeProps(), mergePropsN(), mergeClassNames(), makeEventPreventable(), and useRender().

items.name: announce
items.title: Announce
items.description: Imperative ARIA live-region announcer utility and component for conveying dynamic status updates to screen readers.

items.name: built-in-ai
items.title: Built-in AI
items.description: On-device Built-in AI Hooks (Prompt API, Language Detector, Summarizer & Translator).

items.name: contrast
items.title: Contrast
items.description: Dynamic foreground contrast helper for user-supplied background colors.

items.name: format-duration
items.title: Format Duration
items.description: Locale-safe duration formatter and hook converting seconds or milliseconds into concise human-readable clinical labels.

items.name: sanitize
items.title: Sanitize
items.description: DOMParser-based HTML sanitizer utility and React component blocking unsafe scripts, handlers, and dangerous URLs.

items.name: scheduler
items.title: Scheduler
items.description: Cooperative task scheduling and yielding helpers keeping main-thread interactions responsive during heavy updates.

items.name: scroll-completion
items.title: Scroll Completion
items.description: Programmatic smooth-scroll helper resolving cleanly when animated scrolling reaches its target or is cancelled.

items.name: use-horizontal-scroll-fade
items.title: Use Horizontal Scroll Fade
items.description: Horizontal scroll overflow detection for soft edge-fade masks.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: Use Reduced Motion
items.description: Shared reduced-motion utilities. Subscribes to both the OS-level `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` media query and the document-level `:root[data-motion="reduce"]` override attribute.

items.name: use-text-highlight
items.title: Use Text Highlight
items.description: React hook splitting strings into highlighted and plain segments for live search filtering.

items.name: use-web-otp
items.title: Use Web OTP
items.description: React hook subscribing to navigator.credentials WebOTP one-time verification codes with abort cleanup.

items.name: view-transitions
items.title: View Transitions
items.description: React hook and helper wrapping document.startViewTransition with graceful reduced-motion and fallback handling.

items.name: theme
items.title: Eolas UI Clinical Theme
items.description: Tailwind CSS v4 theme, design tokens, color roles, surface hierarchies, and motion tokens conforming to DESIGN.md.
items.docs: Tailwind CSS v4 @theme tokens, semantic color roles, surface hierarchy, and descendant-scoped inverted surface rules ([data-surface="inverted"]). Writes to `src/eolas-theme.css` (without overwriting an existing non-Eolas stylesheet). Import it inside your main Tailwind CSS entry file (`@import "./eolas-theme.css";` in your `components.json` `tailwind.css` file) — or point `tailwind.css` directly to `src/eolas-theme.css` — so both Tailwind v4 and `@shadcn/lint` resolve all Eolas tokens. Load Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Lexend, Roboto Mono, and Material Symbols Outlined non-blocking via <link rel="stylesheet"> in your document <head> (see README.md).

items.name: design-md
items.title: Eolas UI Design System Spec (DESIGN.md)
items.description: Canonical design tokens, color roles, surface hierarchy, typography, and motion rules for AI agents and developers.

items.name: agent-rules
items.title: Eolas UI Agent Rules & Anti-Pattern Checker
items.description: Strict architectural contracts, AGENTS.md, Antigravity hooks, DESIGN.md tokens, and anti-pattern enforcement scripts for AI agents and developers.
items.docs: For full AST lint enforcement (nested Card, sparkle icons, triple-tint, tertiary contrast, transition-all, spring easing, uppercase, unsafe type casts), also run: npx shadcn@latest add @eolas/lint (or npx @seany9915/eolas-ui add lint).

items.name: lint
items.title: Eolas UI Lint
items.description: @shadcn/lint and Eolas UI Oxlint config for Base UI design contracts.
items.docs: Run "npx oxlint ." to enforce Eolas UI and @shadcn/lint contracts. Ensure your `components.json` `tailwind.css` file imports `./eolas-theme.css` (or points directly to `src/eolas-theme.css`) so `shadcn/no-unknown-classes` recognizes Eolas tokens. If your UI primitives live outside src/components/ui or components/ui, add your custom directory glob to overrides[0].files in .oxlintrc.json.

items.name: logos
items.title: Eolas Brand Logos
items.description: Official Eolas SVG brand marks (stacked primary mark, horizontal lockups, pictorial marks, and wordmarks) aligned with DESIGN.md color tokens.
items.docs: Installs all Eolas SVG brand marks into `public/logos/`. Reference them via `/logos/horizontal-lockup.svg` (or `assetUrl('/logos/horizontal-lockup.svg')` for subpath deployments).

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable and collapsible content sections supporting single or multiple open panels and keyboard navigation on Base UI Accordion.

taxonomy: Use Accordion for vertically stacked disclosure panels where one or more sections can be expanded at a time.
Supports browser in-page search (hiddenUntilFound / hidden="until-found").
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px/48x48px touch targets, and motion restraint.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Modal confirmation dialog requiring explicit user acknowledgment for destructive or irreversible actions, built on Base UI AlertDialog.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: File attachment display and management primitive with file-type metadata, previews, upload progress, and remove actions.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Filterable text input with live popup suggestions, clear button, and grouped results built on Base UI Autocomplete.

taxonomy: Use Autocomplete for freeform text search inputs with dynamic completion suggestions where the user can either select a suggestion or type their own custom query.
For selecting one or more values from a closed set where selections submit explicit item keys, use Combobox or Select instead.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, flush selection indicator, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Circular user or clinician identity badge displaying photography with automatic initials or icon fallback on Base UI Avatar.

taxonomy: Displays a user's profile picture, initials, or fallback icon.
Supports image loading states (idle, loading, loaded, error) and delayed fallback rendering to prevent visual flashes during fast network loads.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant touch targets, and sentence case typography.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact high-contrast status and category pill enforcing filled, outline, and soft-wash clinical palette rules.

taxonomy: Use Badge for PASSIVE, non-interactive status indicators, counts, categories, or labels.
Do NOT use Badge for interactive filters, toggles, or removable tags (use Chip instead).
Implements DESIGN.md High-Contrast Accessible standards:
Pattern 1 (filled): Solid brand fill + high-contrast on-color text.
Pattern 2 (outline): 1px border in color role + neutral white surface fill + colored text.
Pattern 3 (soft): Soft container wash (bg-*-container) + dark neutral charcoal text (on-*-container).
Never uses the banned triple-tint monochrome pattern (light tint + same-hue border + same-hue text).
Full WCAG 2.2 AA contrast compliance.
Polymorphic composition powered by Base UI's `useRender` hook.

items.name: bot-avatar
items.title: Bot Avatar
items.description: Animated geometric avatar primitive for clinical AI assistants, supporting calm and active states with reduced-motion fallbacks.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Hierarchical trail navigation primitive showing current location with accessible landmarks and responsive separators.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Segmented horizontal or vertical container joining adjacent buttons, inputs, and addons with shared borders and focus layering.

taxonomy: A container to group related buttons, segmented actions, and inputs with fused borders and shared geometry.
Resolves double-border artifacts via child border-overlap selectors while ensuring focus rings stay visible with proper stacking context (focus-visible:z-20).
Fuses concentric border radii: rounds outer corners while flattening adjacent internal edges.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 touch target compliance.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Interactive push button with filled, soft, outline, and text variants, 44px minimum touch targets, and reduced-motion loading feedback on Base UI Button.

taxonomy: Use Button for triggering immediate page/dialog actions, form submits, or opening popups.
Do NOT use Button for on/off toggles with persistent state (use Toggle instead).
Do NOT use Button for in-page panel navigation (use Tabs instead).
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius (rounded 8px / 0.5rem), floating 2px focus ring, active micro-motion scaling, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.
Never uses Sunny Amber (tertiary) text on light surfaces without dark container background.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Single-date and date-range month calendar built on React DayPicker with 44px day cells, month selectors, and keyboard navigation.

taxonomy: Use Calendar for date, multiple date, and date range selections.
Integrates with React DayPicker v9/v10 while maintaining complete shadcn/ui API compatibility.
Commonly paired with Popover and Button to form a DatePicker.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Lexend body/cell font (font-sans), Atkinson Hyperlegible Next headings, primary brand selection, surface-container-high range fills, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Elevated containment primitive with Header, Title, Description, Action, Content, and Footer slots following DESIGN.md surface hierarchy.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel primitive built on embla-carousel-react and Base UI.

taxonomy: Provides horizontal and vertical cyclic or bounded content carousels and sliders.
Supports touch/drag gestures, physics-based momentum, and keyboard navigation (Arrow keys).
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B tokens: hairline borders (outline-variant), floating 2px focus rings, motion restraint (duration-quick, ease-standard), and accessible 44px touch targets.
Supports Google-style paired bottom controls with progress bars or floating side navigation.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain Of Thought
items.description: Collapsible multi-step AI reasoning trace showing step status, search results, sources, and elapsed timings.

taxonomy: Displays an AI agent's multi-step execution summary (e.g. "Researched in 4 steps") that smoothly expands to reveal historical reasoning, search, and tool steps.
Follows the shadcn AI Elements migration specification: Rebuilt natively using Trace and Chip/Badge primitives.
Exports: ChainOfThought, ChainOfThoughtHeader, ChainOfThoughtTrigger, ChainOfThoughtContent, ChainOfThoughtStep.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant: 44px minimum touch targets on triggers.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: floating 2px focus ring, semantic tokens, zero triple-tints.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts wrapper providing responsive containers, design-token color scales, accessible tooltips, and formatted legends.

items.name: chat-message-context
items.title: Chat Message Context
items.description: React context provider sharing message role, alignment, and display metadata across ChatMessage subcomponents.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: Structured conversation message row supporting user, assistant, and system alignments, markdown prose, actions, and status metadata.

taxonomy: Use ChatMessage to display conversational turns (user, assistant, system).
Follows DESIGN.md:
Assistant messages use neutral surface fill (`bg-surface`), outline-variant border, calibrated card elevation (`shadow-card`), and `rounded-lg rounded-es-sm`.
User messages use role container fill (`bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container`), `rounded-lg rounded-ee-sm`, and right alignment.
Actions (copy, bookmark, retry) maintain accessible 44x44px touch targets.
Numeric timestamps use `tabular-nums` and `font-mono`.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: CheckboxGroup primitive (@base-ui/react/checkbox-group).

taxonomy: Provides shared state and keyboard management for a list of related checkboxes.
Supports `allValues` for parent indeterminate checkbox synchronization.
Supports both declarative `options` array and composable `children`.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Accessible binary and indeterminate selection control with 44px touch target, error state, and keyboard toggle on Base UI Checkbox.

taxonomy: Use Checkbox for multi-selection or binary on/off options within forms or lists.
Supports three states: unchecked, checked, and indeterminate (mixed).
Supports parent-child tree checkboxes via the `parent` prop.

Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius (rounded-xs / 4px on box, rounded 8px on row), floating 2px focus ring, flush primary fill on check, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.

items.name: checkpoint
items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: Inline conversation milestone divider marking saved thread states with a one-click restore trigger.

taxonomy: Use Checkpoint to mark specific points or milestone states in a conversation thread that a user or clinical agent can return to (e.g. before modifying a clinical plan).
Conforms to shadcn AI Elements Checkpoint specification and DESIGN.md:
Balanced horizontal divider with neutral surface wash.
Accessible 44x44px touch target on the Restore trigger.
Monospace tabular-nums for turn numbering and timestamps.
Single-ring floating 2px focus indicator.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Chip primitive. Built on Base UI (@base-ui/react) interaction foundations.

taxonomy: Use Chip for INTERACTIVE compact elements: 1. Filter chips: Toggleable selection filters with keyboard navigation (aria-pressed). 2. Input/Removable chips: Dismissible tags with accessible remove buttons (onRemove). 3. Action chips: Clickable compact triggers (onClick).
For PASSIVE, non-interactive status labels or counts, use Badge instead.
Implements DESIGN.md High-Contrast Accessible standards:
Pattern 1 (filled): Solid brand fill + high-contrast text.
Pattern 2 (outline): 1px border in color role + neutral white surface fill + colored text.
Pattern 3 (soft): Soft container wash (bg-*-container) + dark neutral charcoal text (on-*-container).

Full WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance (expands to 44px when interactive or removable). For wrapped multi-row interactive chip groups, use `gap-y-3` (12px) or `gap-y-4` (16px) so expanded vertical hit areas do not overlap.
Floating 2px focus ring (outline-offset: 2px) on keyboard focus.

items.name: clinician-tip
items.title: Clinician Tip
items.description: Clinical guidance callout displaying contextual tips and practice notes with subtle elevation and accessible high-contrast typography.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Syntax-styled code viewer supporting language labels, optional line numbers, copy button, and scrollable horizontal overflow.

taxonomy: Displays source code, JSON parameters, database query outputs, and formatted clinical data structures inside agent execution traces or messages.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant: 44px touch targets on copy buttons.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Roboto Mono typography, high-contrast text, concentric radius, and floating 2px focus ring.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Accessible disclosure container with animated panel height and reduced-motion fallback built on Base UI Collapsible.

taxonomy: Use Collapsible for an interactive disclosure element that shows or hides a single panel.
Supports browser in-page search (hiddenUntilFound / hidden="until-found").
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets, and motion restraint.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable single- and multi-select dropdown with chips, grouped options, and clear control built on Base UI Combobox.

taxonomy: Use Combobox for selecting one or multiple values from a list of options with text filtering.
Supports multi-selection with inline chips (Combobox.Chips, Combobox.Chip, Combobox.ChipRemove).
For freeform text searches where custom unlisted queries are valid, use Autocomplete instead.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, flush selection indicator, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Modal keyboard command palette and fuzzy filter list combining cmdk search with accessible Base UI Dialog focus management.

taxonomy: Use Command for fast, accessible command palettes, spotlight search, and quick action menus.
Powered by cmdk for fuzzy searching, keyboard scoring, and grouped item filtering.
CommandDialog integrates Base UI Dialog (with screen-reader accessible DialogTitle and DialogDescription) while retaining complete shadcn Command API compatibility.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Lexend body font (font-sans), Atkinson Hyperlegible Next headings, surface-container-low wash for item selection, and strict semantic tokens.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: Inline clinical or tool approval prompt requesting explicit accept or reject confirmation with outcome feedback.

taxonomy: Dual-purpose component: 1. AI Tool Approval Gate: Conforms to shadcn AI Elements confirmation lifecycle (approval-requested -> approved / denied) for Human-in-the-Loop tool execution. 2. Clinical Decision Gate: Structured inline consent, prescription verification, order sign-off, or risk acknowledgment card in clinical workflows and dashboards.
Conforms to shadcn AI Elements Confirmation specification and DESIGN.md:
High-contrast visual structure with calm clinical amber/neutral tokens.
Clear distinction between pending, approved, and denied states.
WCAG 2.2 compliant 44x44px touch targets on decision buttons.
Floating 2px focus rings (`outline-offset: 2px`).
Concentric radius hierarchy (`rounded-xl` container with `rounded` buttons).

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Pointer-anchored secondary action menu triggered by right-click or long-press, built on Base UI ContextMenu.

items.name: csp-provider
items.title: CSP Provider
items.description: Content Security Policy provider forwarding a cryptographic nonce to Base UI portals and dynamic style elements.

items.name: deferred-view
items.title: Deferred View
items.description: Progressive rendering wrapper deferring heavy offscreen subtrees until idle or visible in the viewport.

taxonomy: Defers layout and paint computations for offscreen or below-the-fold content using CSS `content-visibility: auto`.
Pairs with `contain-intrinsic-size` to prevent layout shifts and scrollbar jumping.
Supports 'hidden' mode for instantaneous view toggling without destroying component DOM state.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: semantic tokens, concentric geometry, and motion restraint.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Accessible modal overlay with backdrop blur, focus trapping, scroll locking, and required DialogTitle semantics on Base UI Dialog.

items.name: direction-provider
items.title: Direction Provider
items.description: Reading direction (LTR/RTL) context provider synchronizing Base UI layout and keyboard behavior across descendant controls.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Viewport-edge slide-over panel with backdrop blur, focus trapping, and logical RTL-aware anchoring on Base UI Drawer.

taxonomy: Use Drawer for slide-over side panels or bottom sheets with swipe dismissal gestures, snap points, and background indent effects.
For focused modal dialogs without swipe gestures, use Dialog instead.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch targets, and motion restraint.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Centered empty and zero-data placeholder displaying a functional icon, plain-English heading, guidance text, and optional action.

taxonomy: Use Empty to display empty states when collections, search results, or tables have no items.
Composable compound architecture:
Empty (Root container)
EmptyHeader (Group wrapper for media, title, and description)
EmptyMedia (Icon / Avatar / Graphic tile with variant="default" | "icon")
EmptyTitle (Headline typography in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next)
EmptyDescription (Body typography in Lexend with accessible link styling)
EmptyContent (Actions and button container)
Also supports monolithic convenience props (icon, title, description, action) for backward compatibility.
Follows DESIGN.md: concentric border radius, semantic high-contrast colors, and text-balance / text-pretty.

items.name: error-shake
items.title: Error Shake
items.description: Horizontal form micro-shake wrapper based on transitions.dev (12-error-state-shake.md).

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field wrapper binding accessible labels, descriptions, validation errors, and invalid state via Base UI Field.

taxonomy: Use Field to group a form control with its label, description, and error message.
Supports automatic validation (onSubmit, onBlur, onChange), validation debouncing, and accessibility attribute wiring (id, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid).
Supports vertical (default) and horizontal layouts (for Switch, Checkbox, Radio).
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Accessible group container with semantic legend and shared description styling on Base UI Fieldset.

taxonomy: Use Fieldset to group related form controls with a shared legend and description.
Cascades disabled state natively to all nested interactive form controls.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Client and schema validation form root coordinating field submission state and error summaries via Base UI Form.

taxonomy: A native form element with consolidated error handling, field registration, imperative validate actions, and external error state integration.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Material Symbols Outlined icon wrapper with standardized size tokens, fill control, ToggleIcon, and CrossFadeIcon helpers.

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: Inline Alert
items.description: Rectangular in-flow feedback banner with a 4px semantic start accent bar, functional icon, description, and optional dismiss control.

taxonomy: Use InlineAlert for high-visibility system event or validation banners (neutral, warning, error, success).
Implements a mathematically straight 4px vertical accent bar, ambient elevation, and accessible live regions.
Supports both monolithic props (title, action, onClose) and compound subcomponents (InlineAlert.Title, InlineAlert.Description, InlineAlert.Action, InlineAlert.Close).
Distinct from ClinicianTip (which is low-prominence instructional micro-guidance) and AlertDialog (modal interrupt).
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next headings (font-heading), Lexend body (font-sans), and semantic color roles.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline Citation
items.description: Superscript inline source marker and hoverable citation card linking generated claims to verified references.

taxonomy: Use InlineCitation to embed source references, RAG grounding passages, and web search literature directly inside prose or assistant messages.
Conforms to DESIGN.md:
Pattern 2 high-contrast citation pill (neutral surface fill, outline-secondary border, Rich Emerald text).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant 44x44px touch target on interactive triggers.
Floating 2px focus ring with 2px offset (outline-primary).
Single-source preview or multi-source Carousel with tabular navigation.
Full keyboard accessibility and prefers-reduced-motion safety.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Compound input container uniting text fields with leading or trailing addons, icons, badges, and inline action buttons without absolute positioning.

taxonomy: Use InputGroup to attach icons, buttons, text prefixes, suffixes, and action toolbars to input fields and textareas.
Bridges single-line search/URL fields and multi-line AI chat prompt inputs under a single visual boundary.
Eliminates double-border and double-focus ring artifacts by delegating focus exclusively to InputGroup.
Integrates seamlessly with Base UI Field (<Field.Control>) for accessible label and error wiring.
Supports polymorphic composition via Base UI's `useRender` hook across all sub-components.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 touch target compliance.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text input supporting 44px/48px touch floors, error borders, and clear invalid messaging on Base UI Input.

taxonomy: A native input element that automatically works with Base UI Field context (<Field.Root>).
Implements Modern Web Guidance (MWG: html) tri-token contract for autocomplete, inputMode, enterKeyHint.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls:
0.5rem corner radius (rounded) matching Buttons as the primary form control.

Flush 2px focus indicator with negative 1px offset (focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-primary) for WCAG 2.4.13 contrast and Windows High Contrast Mode (forced-colors: active) compatibility.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant hit target sizes: sm (44px), md (48px), lg (56px).
For complex input layouts with toolbars, prefixes, suffixes, or multiple buttons, compose with <InputGroup> (@/components/ui/input-group).

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Flexible content row and media object primitive composing leading media, title, description, metadata, and trailing actions in lists and cards.

taxonomy: Use Item and ItemGroup for structured list rows, activity feeds, patient directories, notification trays, and settings rows.
Composes [Media] + [Content (Title, Description)] + [Actions] without custom flex boilerplate.
Directly eliminates the "Card inside Card" anti-pattern by providing a clean, non-elevated content row for lists inside cards and dialogs.
Supports polymorphic composition via Base UI's `useRender` hook across ALL subcomponents.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Lexend body/description font, Lexend label headers, floating 2px focus ring, and strict semantic tokens with zero artificial elevation on list rows.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Compact monospace keycap indicator for displaying keyboard shortcuts inside menus, tooltips, and action buttons.

taxonomy: Use Kbd to visually represent keyboard keys, hotkeys, and shortcut combinations (e.g. ⌘K, Ctrl+B).
Use KbdGroup to compose multiple keycaps together without line breaks.
Ideal for embedding in buttons, command palettes, menus, and tooltips.
Follows DESIGN.md tokens: Roboto Mono font (font-mono), surface-container-high wash, subtle outline-variant border, and strict semantic tokens.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Single-button dropdown action menu with grouped items, radio/checkbox choices, submenus, and keyboard navigation on Base UI Menu.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Horizontal desktop command bar grouping multiple menus with left/right arrow roving focus on Base UI Menubar.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Auto-pinning conversation scroll viewport with smooth stick-to-bottom behavior and a jump-to-latest button when scrolled up.

taxonomy: The foundational viewport engine for conversational AI interfaces, live transcripts, and clinical chat.
Handles smart auto-scrolling: follows incoming streamed tokens when the user is at the live edge, without hijacking the scroll position if the clinician scrolled up to review clinical history.
Turn Anchoring (`scrollAnchor`): Pins new prompt turns near the top with `scrollPreviousItemPeek` visible.
Jump-to-Latest Control: Smooth floating button to return to the live response edge with unread indicators.
Preserves scroll position on historical message prepends (`preserveScrollOnPrepend`).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant: 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive triggers.
Strictly follows DESIGN.md tokens: floating 2px focus ring, semantic colors, zero triple-tints.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Accessible scalar measurement bar showing current values within a bounded range and high-contrast fill on Base UI Meter.

taxonomy: Displays a graphical meter representing a scalar value within a known range (e.g. disk space, battery level, audio volume).
For task progress towards completion, use Progress instead.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, semantic tokens, and motion restraint.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model Selector
items.description: Popover-backed AI model picker with capability badges, search filtering, and keyboard selection.

taxonomy: Use ModelSelector in chat headers, sidebar toolbars, or prompt input footers to let users dynamically switch the active language model and adjust reasoning/thinking effort.
Conforms to shadcn AI Elements ModelSelector specification and DESIGN.md:
Compact, high-precision layout with 44x44px accessible touch bounds.
Clear separation between consumer-provided model items and thinking depth controls.
Concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring (`outline-offset: 2px`).

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation Bar
items.description: NavigationBar primitive (@base-ui/react/button + semantic `<nav>`).

taxonomy: High-frequency mobile bottom navigation bar (3 to 5 primary destinations).
Placed at the bottom edge of mobile and compact viewports for ergonomic thumb reach.
Conforms to DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls:
44x44px minimum touch target per destination (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8).
Active indicator: soft `bg-primary-container` pill wash with `text-on-primary-container` ink.
Inactive items: `text-on-surface-variant` with hover lift to `text-on-surface`.

items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Controlled multi-question assessment block with choice controls, validation summaries, and conditional step progression.

taxonomy: Multi-step guided question primitive and flow engine for intake forms, assessments, onboarding sequences, configuration wizards, and conversational agent clarification prompts.

Follows the shadcn/ui Questionnaire part structure and API: Root, Progress, Item, Title, Description, Choices, Choice, ChoiceInput, ChoiceLabel, ChoiceShortcut, Input, Error, Actions, Previous, Skip, Next, and Submit. Items take `multiple` (the legacy `type="multiple"` still works) and answers serialize to FormData with one repeated entry per selected value (`FormData.getAll(name)`). Choices are role-based rather than native radio/checkbox inputs.

Supports single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform text entry, keyboard shortcuts (A-Z, 1-9), roving tabindex arrow key navigation, form validation, draft restoration, and native FormData serialization.

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (min-h-11 touch targets), floating 2px focus indicators, fieldset/legend semantics, inert inactive items, live error regions, and container-query responsiveness (@container).

items.name: step-wizard
items.title: Step Wizard
items.description: Controlled multi-step workflow block with step sidebar, validation gates, hidden until-found preservation, and review actions.

taxonomy: Controlled multi-step workflow container for guided intake, onboarding, assessment flows, and multi-stage form sequences.
Pure UI: receives step data via props, manages directional slide transitions, and emits progression intents via callbacks (`onStepChange`, `onComplete`).

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (44x44px minimum touch targets on all interactive step markers and buttons), floating 2px focus indicators (`outline-offset: 2px`), and live regions (`aria-live="polite"`).
Modern HTML integration: supports `hiddenUntilFound` with `hidden="until-found"` and `beforematch` event listener so browser search (<kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd>) finds inactive step content.

items.name: supporting-pane-block
items.title: Supporting Pane Block
items.description: Controlled main workspace plus collapsible right-hand context pane for clinical references, notes, or AI assistance.

taxonomy: Canonical supporting pane layout for focused tasks (audio drill canvas, exercise workspace) paired with an auxiliary side inspector (clinician tips, phonetic targets, session notes).
Implements responsive container queries (`@container`):
On large containers (`@3xl:` / `>=768px`): Side-by-side layout with docked pane (left or right).
On compact containers (`<768px`): Full-width stacked layout below the primary workspace.
On compact height (`short:`): Tightens top bar height while preserving 44px touch target focus rings.
Targeted opacity transition (`duration-quick`, zero `transition-all`) with reduced-motion fallback.
Restores keyboard focus cleanly when closed from inside the pane and marks closed panes inert.
Zero direct `<button>` tags outside primitives.
